name: typescript
text:
export interface ArchiveEntry { id: string; content: string; }
export function restoreArchive(entries: ReadonlyArray<ArchiveEntry>): Map<string, string> { return new Map(entries.map((entry) => [entry.id, entry.content])); }

name: haskell
text:
module Main where
import Data.List (intercalate)
restore :: [String] -> String
restore entries = intercalate "\n" entries
main :: IO ()
main = putStrLn $ restore ["archive", "document"]

name: php
text:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
function restoreArchive(array $entries): string { return implode("\n", $entries); }
foreach (["archive", "document"] as $entry) { echo htmlspecialchars($entry, ENT_QUOTES, "UTF-8"); }
?>
